name: cloudbase
description: Tencent CloudBase for Kimi Code / Kimi Work — PostgreSQL/MySQL/NoSQL, cloud functions, cloud storage, CloudRun, Auth, and static hosting via cloudbase-mcp, plus a routing skill and lifecycle hooks. Format pinned to Kimi Code 0.34.0 (2026-08-18); plugin system is Beta.
author: Tencent CloudBase
skillInstructions: CloudBase credentials come from `tcb login` (or a CloudBase API Key), never from Kimi inject mappings. Prefer this plugin's MCP tools. If MCP is missing in this session, run tcb now and configure MCP for the next session. Fetch domain skills on demand with searchKnowledgeBase(mode=skill, skillName="...").

interface.shortDescription: CloudBase databases, functions, storage, CloudRun, Auth, and hosting from Kimi
interface.longDescription:
Installs CloudBase as a native Kimi plugin: MCP tools + a routing skill + lifecycle hooks, the same shape as a Claude Code plugin.

What you can do after install:
- Databases: query and manage PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL / data models
- Cloud functions: list, deploy, invoke, and inspect logs
- Cloud storage: upload, list, and manage objects
- CloudRun: inspect and manage container / function-mode services
- Auth: environment login and app auth providers (do not mix Web SDK login with Mini Program OPENID)
- Hosting: deploy and preview static Web apps

Credentials: run `tcb login` (Tencent Cloud device code) or `tcb login --cloudbase-api-key <key> -e <envId>`. Kimi inject api_key / base_url are LLM keys, not Tencent Cloud credentials.

After `/plugins install`, run `/reload` or start a new session. Then try:
- 登录云开发
- 列出当前环境的云函数
- 查一下 PostgreSQL 里有哪些表
- 列出云存储根目录和 CloudRun 服务
- 部署静态托管

Manifest format: Kimi Code 0.34.0 kimi.plugin.json. Logo uses the GitHub raw URL for plugin/cloudbase/assets/logo.png because official Kimi plugins (kimi-cu) ship interface.iconUrl as an HTTPS URL; relative logo paths are not documented.

hooks.matcher: (?i)(cloudbase|tcb\b|envId|云开发|云函数|云存储|云托管|CloudRun|静态托管)
